hero.heading: Scam With Your Friends Release Date & Early Access
hero.lead: Steam currently lists Scam With Your Friends for Early Access in October 2026 on Windows PC. An exact release day is not currently shown on the main listing. A full release around mid-December 2026 is a developer target, not a guaranteed date.

sections.heading: Scam With Your Friends Release Date
sections.intro: If you only need the window, use the current Steam listing. It shows October 2026 and does not display an exact day.

subsections.heading: Planned Early Access Window: October 2026
paragraphs: October 2026 is the planned Early Access window on the current Steam listing, not a promise that the build is finished or that the clock cannot move. No exact release day is currently displayed. Steam is showing a wishlist for App ID 4954910 rather than a buy button. When the window arrives, availability still depends on the store page staying on that window and on the build actually releasing.

The [home guide](/) keeps the same window next to playtest, price, and platform status. Those topics change for different reasons, so a date shift would not by itself announce a price or a new console.

subsections.heading: Where the Date Comes From
paragraphs: The date comes from the official Steam store page for Scam With Your Friends, published by Jatater Worldwide and developed by JakeHub and Metater. That listing is the authority when a video, a repost, or an old search snippet names a different month.

On September 23, 2026, the Steam page also carried the news that the game had reached 100,000 wishlists. Wishlist count is interest, not a release commitment, but it is a useful sign that the store page is the channel the developers are using for public milestones.

sections.heading: Early Access vs Full Release
paragraphs: Early Access and the full release are two different milestones. Buying or playing during Early Access, once a price exists, would mean playing the version the developers choose to ship on the way to 1.0. The retail price itself is still not announced. See the [price guide](/price/) before you assume what that launch will cost.

subsections.heading: What Early Access Means for This Game
paragraphs: For Scam With Your Friends, Early Access is the planned first public Steam launch on Windows PC. It is the point where the game is scheduled to leave the limited playtest and open through the normal Steam page. It does not mean every feature is final, and it does not mean a console version appears on the same day.

The playtest that is already running is a separate, limited program. Closed signups and friend invites are explained on the [playtest access page](/playtest-key/). Getting into that test is not the same thing as the planned October 2026 Early Access launch.

subsections.heading: Full Release Target
paragraphs: The Early Access notes on Steam target a full release around mid-December 2026. Treat that as an estimate the developers are aiming at. Mid-December is a window, not a locked calendar day, and the notes do not promise that every system will be unchanged between Early Access and 1.0.

The current listing does not turn the October 2026 window into a guaranteed day. If the listing moves, the new Steam date replaces this one. Steam does not currently explain why the listing is shown as a monthly window instead of a specific day.

sections.heading: Is There an Exact Release Day Yet?
paragraphs: The current official Steam page says October 2026. No exact day is currently displayed, so treat that month as the planned Early Access window rather than a guaranteed calendar day.

Cached or older results may still show a more specific date. When those disagree with the live store page, the current Steam listing takes priority. Check the store page again closer to launch, because a planned window is allowed to change.

sections.heading: What Is Confirmed for Early Access
sections.intro: These are features the official materials already describe. They are not a promise about how much content the Early Access build will contain on day one.
bullets: Single-player, plus online co-op and public lobbies.
Real-time conversations with fictional AI callers.
Run-based progression through a scam-call-center workday.
Remote computer access and in-game desktop tools.
paragraphs: Minimum PC specs and the list of platforms that are not announced are on the [platforms page](/platforms/). Modding, JSON personalities, WAV voice cloning, and workplace events such as scambaiters, viruses, raids, and air strikes are also part of the public feature list. None of those lines publish a content-complete checklist for the October 2026 window.

sections.heading: How to Track Release Changes
paragraphs: Wishlist the Steam page so store updates are easier to catch. Join the official Jatater Worldwide Discord for playtest news and launch discussion. The publisher's own game page is the other place that would carry a direct announcement.
Three links are enough. You do not need a countdown site or a third-party key shop to hear that the date moved.

hero.heading: Scam With Your Friends Playtest Key & Access
hero.lead: Playtest signups for Scam With Your Friends are closed after more than 12,000 requests. Limited access has been granted in batches, and an accepted tester can invite up to three friends. There is no legitimate key generator. The official US$8 Unlimited AI purchase is not a game key and does not grant playtest entry.

sections.heading: Scam With Your Friends Playtest Status
sections.intro: This is the access picture as of October 3, 2026. Official playtest access is not distributed as a public key list.

table.caption: Playtest status for Scam With Your Friends

paragraphs: The Steam page sends players to Discord for playtest updates and for finding teammates. That is the official path. A download button on an unrelated site, a pasted key in a comment, or a generator is not.

The planned Early Access launch is separate from this test. Even if you never receive playtest access, the store date is still the public plan for the wider release. Follow it on the [release date page](/release-date/).

sections.heading: How Playtest Access Works
paragraphs: Access is controlled by the developers through Steam and the channels they name. There is no supported way around that process.

subsections.heading: Existing Signup / Batch Access
paragraphs: The signup wave already passed. More than 12,000 people requested access, and the team has been letting players in gradually rather than opening the test to everyone who asked. If you signed up earlier, you are waiting on that batch process. If you never signed up, there is no open form to submit right now.
A closed signup does not mean the test is finished. It means new requests are not being taken. Watch the Steam news feed and the official Discord rather than refreshing unofficial key threads.

subsections.heading: Friend Invites
paragraphs: An accepted tester can invite up to three friends. That invite has to come from someone who already has access, inside the official rules. Asking in the Discord for teammates is reasonable. Buying a supposed spare key, or using a code someone cannot show on Steam, is not the invite system.
Three friends is the published cap. It is not a code you can split endlessly, and it is not a public guest pass.

sections.heading: Is There a Scam With Your Friends Key?
paragraphs: People search for a Scam With Your Friends key because they want to play before the public launch. In this case the word key means playtest access, not a list of redeem codes. Steam playtest access is granted to accounts. It is not the same thing as a public coupon page.

There are no official redeem codes to publish here. There is no key generator that creates real access. This site does not sell keys, trade invites, or collect Steam passwords. If a page asks you to log into Steam on a domain that is not Steam, close it.

The planned way onto the full release is the Steam store page when Early Access opens. Until then, the only access paths the developers have described are the closed signup batches and invites from accepted testers.

sections.heading: Is There a Public Demo or Free Download?
paragraphs: Steam currently presents the limited playtest, not a normal public demo that anyone can install. A free-download search usually lands on the same access question. The playtest is not a permanent free version of the game, and the retail release is still planned as a paid Early Access launch once a price exists.

Do not download an executable, a cracked build, or a repack from a third-party file host. The official entries are the Steam page and the Jatater Worldwide game page. Anything else is outside those channels. The [price page](/price/) explains why the game should not be described as free-to-play just because a price has not been posted.

sections.heading: What the $8 Unlimited AI Purchase Actually Is
paragraphs: Jatater Worldwide sells a separate one-time Unlimited AI purchase for US$8, plus applicable taxes shown at checkout. The official terms say it buys unlimited AI access for the Scam With Your Friends playtest only, and only while that playtest service is available. One purchaser covers their lobby. Access is tied to the verified Steam account.

The same terms are explicit about what the charge is not. It is not a subscription. It is not a game key. It is not playtest entry. It is not a purchase of the full game. You must already have played the playtest on the linked Steam account before you can buy it. The full game is stated to include unlimited AI credits, so this $8 option is a playtest-only bridge, not the game itself.

Internet access and the playtest service have to be available for the purchase to matter. Activation questions go to the publisher, including through the official Discord, not to a random seller. Read the terms on the Jatater site before you pay, and use the [price guide](/price/) if you are trying to tell this charge apart from the unannounced retail price.

title: How to Play Scam With Your Friends | Beginner Guide
description: Learn how to play Scam With Your Friends: take AI-driven calls, build trust, use desktop tools, hit the team quota, and survive the boss review.

scam with your friends beginner guide

hero.heading: How to Play Scam With Your Friends
hero.lead: You run a fictional scam call center. You talk with fictional AI callers in real time, use the in-game desktop and remote-access tools, and earn toward a daily quota while the workday gets more chaotic. The shift is judged in a boss review. The current official information confirms this core loop, while exact payout values and some balance details are not yet listed.

sections.heading: Scam With Your Friends Gameplay Loop
sections.intro: The game is still ahead of its planned Early Access launch. The steps below follow the loop the developers have described: start a shift, take live calls, use the desktop tools, chase the daily quota, and face the review.

steps.heading: Start a run or join a lobby
steps.description: Play solo, join friends in online co-op, or use a public lobby. A maximum player count has not been published.

steps.heading: Take calls from fictional AI characters
steps.description: The callers are fictional and AI-driven. They are the work of the shift, not a menu of fixed scripts with posted rewards.

steps.heading: Talk and improvise in real time
steps.description: Conversation is live. You respond to what the caller does instead of following a single published dialogue tree.

steps.heading: Use the in-game desktop and remote-access tools
steps.description: When the call calls for it, you use remote computer access and the desktop tools inside the game. Use only what the scenario is showing you.

steps.heading: Work toward the daily quota
steps.description: The team has a daily quota. Steam does not currently list a fixed daily-quota amount.

steps.heading: Face the performance review
steps.description: The boss review is the judgment on the shift. Missing the quota is framed as getting fired, and later workdays are described as more chaotic.

paragraphs: That sequence is the whole public overview. The [release date](/release-date/) tells you when a wider Steam audience is planned to see it. Until then, only the limited playtest is available, and new signups are closed.

sections.heading: Talking to AI Callers
paragraphs: The callers are fictional characters driven by AI. They respond to the conversation and to what you do during the call, which is why the game is built around real-time voice rather than a static chat tree. Building the call is the job. Steam does not currently publish a numeric Caller Trust threshold.
Plan on speaking. The game is presented with voice control and live conversation. A text-only alternative has not been officially detailed, so a muted, click-only playthrough is not confirmed.

JSON personalities and WAV voice cloning are listed as modding features. They are tools for changing characters, not a published ranking of which caller pays the most. No caller payout table exists in the public materials.

sections.heading: Using the In-Game Desktop
paragraphs: Remote access to the other person's computer is part of the fiction. You are not leaving the game to control a real machine. The in-game desktop is where the call's tools live. Official features include a paint app, a screen recorder, and a camera, alongside the remote-access system.

Those tools are there so the scenario can ask you to use them. Specific tool stats, cooldowns, and upgrade behavior are not currently listed. If a call wants a screenshot, a drawing, or the camera, the in-game desktop is where you do that.

Broadband internet is required for the game as a whole, which fits a title built on live calls and online lobbies. The full minimum spec list is on the [platforms and PC requirements page](/platforms/).

sections.heading: Daily Quotas and the Boss Review
paragraphs: Each run is aimed at a daily quota. The official description is progression through a workday that becomes more chaotic, not a published dollar amount per call. Specific payout values, spawn rates, and scam-app profit requirements are not currently published.

The performance review is the boss's verdict on that work. The framing players should expect is simple: hit the quota or get fired. There is no public formula for partial credit, overtime, or a hidden mercy mechanic. Later shifts are described as harder and messier, which is the run-based climb.

Co-op does not change the published goal. You are still a call-center crew trying to make the number. It does mean a friend can share the lobby, within whatever player count the build actually allows. That count is not listed yet.

sections.heading: Single-Player, Co-op and Public Lobbies
paragraphs: You can play Scam With Your Friends solo. Official modes also include online co-op with friends and public lobbies, so the same call-center shift can be a team job. The Steam page points playtest players toward Discord when they need teammates.

No maximum lobby size has been announced. If you are still trying to get into the test itself, the invite rule is separate from lobby size: an accepted tester can invite up to three friends. That rule is about access, not about how many characters fit in a shift.

Public lobbies are confirmed as a mode. They are not a promise that a matchmaking queue is open to everyone before launch. Playtest access is still limited. The [Discord guide](/discord/) is the place to look for teammates once you are allowed in.

sections.heading: Scambaiters, Viruses and Workplace Disasters
sections.intro: These show up on the official feature list. They are interruptions to the workday, not boss fights with published health bars.
bullets: Scambaiters, who exist to waste the call center's time.
Other workplace disasters that break up the shift.
paragraphs: The confirmed hazards include scambaiters, computer viruses, police raids, air strikes, and other workplace disasters. Scambaiters are described as callers who waste the center's time. Viruses, raids, air strikes, and the other disasters interrupt the workday during a run. Detailed encounter rules are not yet listed.

Modding is also an official feature, including JSON personalities and WAV voice cloning. The game is described as moddable. A curated mod browser and install steps for community mods are not currently listed.

sections.heading: What You Need Before You Play
paragraphs: You need the PC Steam is specifying, a broadband connection, and access to the game. Access today is the limited playtest. The wider launch is the planned Early Access date on the [release page](/release-date/). A microphone is the sensible plan because calls are voice-led, with the caveat above that a text-only mode has not been detailed.

paragraphs: Playtest feedback and bug reports are part of why the server exists. If you are in the test and something breaks, the Discord is the community channel the publisher is using. A store review is a different tool and is not a substitute for a bug report during a limited test.

subsections.heading: Playtest / Unlimited AI Support

Do not enter your Steam name and password on a page that is not Steam. Playtest access is tied to Steam accounts by the developers. No fan site, including this one, needs your login to explain the rules.

The US$8 Unlimited AI purchase lives only on the official Jatater page. If another site sells a Scam With Your Friends key and calls it the same $8, it is not that product. The real charge is playtest AI access for people who already have the test, not a game key and not a ticket in.

faq.question: What is the Scam With Your Friends price?
faq.answer: The retail price has not been announced. Steam currently offers a wishlist instead of a purchase price.

faq.question: Is Scam With Your Friends free?
faq.answer: It has not been announced as free-to-play. No retail price is listed yet, and there is no public free download of the full game.

faq.question: Is the game $8?
faq.answer: No. The $8 charge is a one-time Unlimited AI option for the playtest. It is not the retail price of Scam With Your Friends.

faq.question: Does $8 include a key?
faq.answer: No. The official terms say the purchase is not a game key and not a purchase of the full game.

faq.question: Does $8 give playtest access?
faq.answer: No. It is not playtest entry. The terms require you to have already played the playtest on the linked Steam account.

faq.question: Will the price change after Early Access?
faq.answer: The developers currently expect the same price through Early Access and full release, but full-release pricing is not finalized and plans can change. No price is locked because none has been announced.

faq.question: Can I pre-order it?
faq.answer: Steam does not currently show a pre-order or a retail buy button. Wishlist the official page instead of using an unofficial key shop.

title: Scam With Your Friends Platforms | Xbox, PS5 & Mobile
description: See where Scam With Your Friends is available, including Windows Steam support and the current status of Xbox, PlayStation, Mac, Linux, mobile and Roblox.

hero.heading: Scam With Your Friends Platforms
hero.lead: The only currently announced platform for Scam With Your Friends is Windows PC via Steam. No official Xbox, PlayStation, Switch, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS, or Roblox version has been announced. Steam Deck compatibility is not confirmed or rated yet. Not announced means not announced. It does not mean a version can never exist.

sections.heading: Scam With Your Friends Platform Status
sections.intro: This table matches the public listing on October 3, 2026. The planned Windows date is Early Access, and it can still change. See the [release date page](/release-date/) for that plan.

table.caption: Announced platforms for Scam With Your Friends
rows: Announced. Planned Early Access in October 2026; exact day not announced.

paragraphs: JakeHub and Metater develop the game. Jatater Worldwide publishes it. The store page to wishlist is Steam App ID 4954910. A price is still not listed, which the [price guide](/price/) explains separately from the platform list.

sections.heading: Is Scam With Your Friends on Xbox?
paragraphs: No. Scam With Your Friends is not announced for Xbox Series X, Xbox Series S, or Xbox One. The only platform on the official listing is Windows PC through Steam. There is no Xbox release date, no Game Pass announcement, and no console roadmap to quote.

Searching the game name plus Xbox usually means you want to know if the console you own can run it. Today the answer is that Microsoft has not been given a version in any public JakeHub, Metater, or Jatater Worldwide notice. If that changes, it will be an announcement, not a quiet unlock. Until then, a Windows PC that meets the Steam minimums is the machine the developers are targeting.
Do not install an unofficial Xbox build or a remote-play workaround from a video description. Those are not the game the publisher is shipping.

sections.heading: Is Scam With Your Friends on PS5 or PlayStation?
paragraphs: No PlayStation version has been announced. That includes PS5 and PS4. There is no PlayStation store page to wishlist alongside Steam, and there is no stated plan for a console launch beside the planned October 2026 Windows Early Access window.
The same rule covers Nintendo Switch. It is not on the announced list. No console release window has been announced.

If you only have a PlayStation, there is nothing official to buy or preload. PlayStation users can watch the Steam page and the official Jatater Worldwide Discord for any future platform announcement.

sections.heading: Is Scam With Your Friends on Mac, Linux or Steam Deck?
paragraphs: The Steam listing is Windows only: Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Mac is not announced. Linux is not announced. There is no macOS build and no SteamOS or native Linux build in the current public requirements.
Steam Deck compatibility is currently unconfirmed. Steam does not list a Deck Verified, Playable, or Unsupported rating for the game yet.

If you are on a Mac or a Linux desktop, treat the game as unannounced for that system. Check the Steam system list again near the [planned Early Access date](/release-date/) in case the store page adds a platform. Adding one would be a change. It is not something you can assume from the Windows spec.

sections.heading: Is Scam With Your Friends on Mobile?
paragraphs: No Android version has been announced. No iOS or iPhone version has been announced. There is no official App Store or Google Play listing for this Steam game.

Do not sideload an APK, an IPA, or a mobile client that uses the name. The game described here is the Windows PC title from JakeHub, Metater, and Jatater Worldwide. A phone build has not been part of that announcement. Cloud streaming and remote desktop are also not official mobile versions.

The gameplay itself asks for a broadband connection and an in-game desktop with voice. That description is about the PC game. It is not a mobile control scheme, because no mobile control scheme has been published.

sections.heading: Is There a Roblox Version?
paragraphs: No official Roblox version of Scam With Your Friends has been announced. This page is about the Steam game from JakeHub and Metater, published by Jatater Worldwide. It is not a guide to other experiences that happen to use a similar name.

If you found a Roblox place with overlapping words, that place is not the Steam App ID 4954910 release. The Windows Steam listing is the announced way to play this game, once you have access or once Early Access opens.
The [how to play guide](/how-to-play/) covers the PC call-center loop: live AI callers, the in-game desktop, the daily quota, and the boss review. Those systems belong to the Steam game.

sections.heading: PC System Requirements
sections.intro: These are the minimums currently printed on Steam. A recommended tier above this list has not been the focus of the public page, so only the minimums are repeated here.

table.caption: Steam minimum requirements for Scam With Your Friends

paragraphs: Broadband is required, not optional. The game is built around real-time calls and online modes. Five gigabytes is the storage figure on the listing today. Check Steam again before you install, because store requirements can be edited.

Meeting the minimum does not create playtest access. Hardware and an invite are different problems. The [playtest guide](/playtest-key/) covers invites. Your PC only matters once Steam will actually let the account download the game.
